evidence_scopes: All statuses are local mathematical claim gates; no physical interpretation is automatically promoted.

interfaces.title: C1 source-free Einstein-Maxwell bulk-action projection
interfaces.domain: Classical Lorentzian metric (-+++), Mpl²>0, smooth Abelian gauge field; compact-support variations and appropriate boundary terms if deriving field equations.
restriction: All eight neutral scalar fields identically zero
B and its field strength H identically zero
All pair and triple interaction coefficients g_ij and h_ijk set zero, including g_EM
Retain metric g, A field, Mpl² and Lambda
interfaces.target: Einstein–Hilbert bulk density with cosmological constant + Maxwell -F²/4
interfaces.proof_method: Exact polynomial rewriting; known variational equations separately stated analytically
limitations: Does not derive Einstein-Maxwell equations afresh in a proof assistant
Does not reproduce full Standard Model or quantized gravity
No unique EFMW source term remains in this subfamily

interfaces.title: C1 Maxwell gauge kinetic expression to SM hypercharge gauge kinetic expression
interfaces.domain: Classical U(1)_Y kinetic density, no Higgs/fermion/SU2/SU3 fields, fixed-background SM (+---) compared to C1 (-+++)
restriction: SM SU3 and SU2 gauge strengths zero
Identify hypercharge strength B_{mu nu} with C1 F_{mu nu}
Map SM (+---) metric to g_SM=-g_C1; compare only F²
interfaces.target: -X/4 in the kinetic expression; full restricted SM density differs by -lambda*v^4/4
limitations: No same-convention gravity action or stress-tensor equivalence established
No full chiral/Yukawa or quantum Standard Model mapping

interfaces.title: EFMW-inspired source split: conditional source-only nonidentifiability
interfaces.domain: Real Fin4×Fin4 component arrays, scalar kappa, ordinary T free to reallocate, observations depending only on S=T+kappa I
interfaces.limitation: Does not establish a covariant spacetime tensor map or observational no-go with independently fixed matter; original Geometry theorem already existed
interfaces.negative_control: When T is separately known and I nonzero, S(T,I,kappa)!=S(T,I,0) for kappa nonzero in constructed cases

interfaces.title: Full EFMW informational stress to physical gravitational source
required: Define a covariant informational stress tensor with physical units and actual field dynamics
Verify divergence/energy exchange with standard matter and gravity
Define operational kappa, a strong kappa=0 comparator and independently calibrated observation
Avoid circular choice of T or measurement-derived I

interfaces.title: Full classical/quantum Standard Model integration
required: Correct full signature and curvature conventions
All gauge, Higgs, chiral, Yukawa and CP terms
Correctly handle vacuum energy and quantization
Preserve observed SM parameters; no free-parameter elimination claimed

interfaces.title: Coupled Einstein-Maxwell/EFMW dynamical correspondence
required: Independent continuum variational derivation with boundary conditions
A nontrivial on-shell coupled solution or theorem
Formal or independently reproducible PDE checks
